*Last updated: 23 November 2026*

## Who is responsible

The controller under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) is Pietro Sala, Breisacher
Straße 17, 81667 München, Germany, CONTACT_EMAIL. See the [legal notice](impressum.qmd).

## In short

This site has no user accounts, no cookies, no analytics and no advertising. We do not collect
names or email addresses. The only personal data processed when you visit is your network (IP)
address and basic browser information, which the services below need to deliver the pages.

## Hosting: GitHub Pages

The site is hosted on GitHub Pages, a service of GitHub, Inc., 88 Colin P. Kelly Jr. Street, San
Francisco, CA 94107, USA. When you open a page, GitHub processes your IP address, the page
requested, the time, and your browser and operating system, to deliver the page and keep the
service secure. GitHub may log this information. Legal basis: our legitimate interest in
publishing the site (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). This involves a transfer to the USA; GitHub relies on the
EU standard contractual clauses for such transfers. Details: GitHub's privacy statement,
https://docs.github.com/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement

## Fonts and formula display

Pages load the *Inter* and *Source Sans Pro* typefaces from Google Fonts (Google Ireland Limited,
Gordon House, Barrow Street, Dublin 4, Ireland; parent company Google LLC, USA), which processes
your IP address to send the font files. Some pages with mathematical formulas load the MathJax
library from jsDelivr (operated by Prospect One, Poland) and a small compatibility script from
cdnjs (Cloudflare, Inc., USA); both process your IP address. Legal basis: our legitimate interest
in a consistent and readable display (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). Google LLC and Cloudflare, Inc. are
certified under the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework.

## Reader questions page

*This section applies once the page is live.* On the Questions page you can vote for questions and
suggest new ones. The page uses services of Cloudflare, Inc., 101 Townsend Street, San Francisco,
CA 94107, USA:

- **Spam check (Cloudflare Turnstile):** checks your IP address and browser signals to tell people
  from automated programs. No cookies are set for this.
- **Question service (Cloudflare Workers and D1):** stores the text and region of a suggested
  question and the votes per question. To limit repeated votes and spam, it stores a code derived
  from your IP address with a secret value that changes every day, so the code cannot be turned
  back into the address. These codes are deleted after 30 days. Your IP address itself is not
  stored.

Please do not include personal details in a question. We review every question before it is
shown, may reword it, and publish only our wording. Questions we do not list are deleted after
triage; listed questions are removed from the page at the latest 90 days after listing, and their
text is deleted from the question service 30 days later. Legal basis: our legitimate interest in
running the page and protecting it from abuse (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). Cloudflare is certified under
the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework. Details: https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/

## Links to other sites

Posts link to LinkedIn, GitHub and the sources we use. These sites are only contacted when you
follow a link; their own privacy policies apply.

## Your rights

You have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data
portability and to object to processing based on legitimate interest (Art. 15–21 GDPR). As we
store no names or contact details, we usually cannot link data to you; write to us at the address
above if you have a request. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory
authority, for example the Bayerisches Landesamt für Datenschutzaufsicht (BayLDA), Promenade 18,
91522 Ansbach, Germany.
